legend: Tissue fragment showing prominent anastomosing vasculature, and large cells with abundant clear to pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and mildly atypical hyperchromatic nuclei (Giemsa).

Scattered, discohesive large cells with marked anisonucleosis, large prominent nucleoli, and scant non-vacuolated cytoplasm. Some cells show melanin pigment in the cytoplasm, which must be differentiated from haemosiderin in macrophages (Pap).
Isolated, scattered single cells exhibiting large nuclei and characteristic marked nucleoli. Melanin shows as dense dark-blue granules in the cytoplasm (Giemsa).
Tissue fragment of colonic adenocarcinoma showing columnar cells forming a palisading glandular architecture (Pap).

Tissue fragment showing a glandular architecture with columnar cells in a palisading arrangement, along with few small vacuoles in the eccentric cytoplasm and large hyperchromatic, often elongated nuclei (Giemsa).

Clear cell renal cell carcinoma exhibiting large cells with abundant foamy cytoplasm and round, mildly pleomorphic, hyperchromatic nuclei with prominent nucleoli. This pattern can be mistaken for the foamy gland pattern of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (Pap).
Cell block shows a tissue fragment with a nested pattern, showing nests of neoplastic cells separated by interlacing stroma with some inflammatory cells (H&E).

Cell block showing a tissue fragment of carcinoma, showing strongly positive nuclear staining for PAX8. Note that pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours (PanNETs) may also express PAX8, depending on the antibody (ICC).
The cells show cytoplasmic, granular expression of renal cell antigen (immunoperoxidase).
The cells show membranous expression for CAIX (immunoperoxidase).
Cell block shows a large tissue fragment of tumour, which shows positive HMB45 cytoplasmic expression (ICC).
